result: Five resumable generated C.R.I.S.T. stage surfaces (context→role→interview→spec→tasks): each has a primary canonical action (operation:genesis.*), autosave/resume via draft:genesis:* id, explicit recovery states (error/retry/resume), and terminal fallback truth = canonical_projection (surface is presentation-only; UXP/UFI never alters authority, required proof, or safety). Unknown stages fail closed; primary actions resolve only through the permission projection.
